en: What does it take to kill you, eh? Why will you not die?

speaker: Ezio
en: Don't you ever stop howling?

speaker: Leandros
en: Well, the old hound still has a bite.

speaker: Ezio
en: The book you carry. Where is it?

speaker: Leandros
en: Ah! Niccolò Polo's journal? This will do no good, not now. We have found one of the Masyaf keys already, and are closing in on the rest.

speaker: Ezio
en: What is in that library is not for you. Not the Templars.

speaker: Leandros
en: Ah, you can have Altaïr's books, Ezio. We only want guidance. We only want directions... to the location of the Grand Temple.

speaker: Ezio
en: Grand Temple? Tell me more. Now!

speaker: Ezio
en: Requiescat in pace... bastardo (bastard).

speaker: Mario
en: Ezio!

speaker: Ezio
en: It is time, uncle. Let us finish what you and my father started all those years ago...

speaker: Mario
en: Indeed. Perhaps now we can finally make sense of this prophecy – and put a stop to whatever it is the Spaniard is plotting.

speaker: Ezio
en: We should start by locating the Vault. The Codex pages will lead us to it. Let's take a look.

speaker: Ezio
en: It... It is a map of the entire world... But... there are lands shown here that do not exist...

speaker: Machiavelli
en: Apparently they do exist. I imagine they've yet to be discovered. Or rediscovered...

speaker: Ezio
en: How is this possible?

speaker: Machiavelli
en: Perhaps the Vault will hold the answer.

speaker: Paola
en: Do you see where it is then?

speaker: Ezio
en: No! It can't be! The Vault... It looks like the Vault is in Roma. Then the Spaniard... This is why he became Pope!

speaker: Mario
en: Now I understand! It's not the Vault alone he's gained access to – but the staff as well!

speaker: Teodora
en: What staff?

speaker: Mario
en: The Codex always spoke of two keys... two Pieces of Eden needed to open the Vault. One is the Apple...

speaker: Ezio
en: And the other is the staff... The Papal Staff is the second Piece of Eden.

speaker: Mario
en: For years... No, decades... We have sought these answers.

speaker: Paola
en: And now, at last, we have them...

speaker: Antonio
en: But so too could the Spaniard... And if he does... if he finds a way into the Vault... Its contents will make the Apple seem a trifling thing.

speaker: Ezio
en: I must go to Roma and find the Vault. What of the rest of you?

speaker: Bartolomeo
en: We'll do what we do best, cause some trouble in the city, giving you the freedom to conduct your search.

speaker: Mario
en: Just let me know when you are ready, nipote (nephew).

speaker: Guard 1
en: Ti distihìa! (What misery!) Do you know how long we've been searching this filthy Cistern?

speaker: Guard 2
en: I've been here a few weeks.

speaker: Guard 1
en: Thirteen months! Ever since the Grand Master found that damned key. But he hasn't got a clue what he's doing. All he knows is they're somewhere in the city.

speaker: Guard 2
en: This is a big city.

speaker: Guard 1
en: To xèro! (I know!) That's what I said.

speaker: Captain 1
en: Back to your posts, agìrtes (bums)!

speaker: Guard 3
en: It stinks down here. We'll find the keys soon.

speaker: Captain 1
en: Look alive, eh? We pay you to watch the doors, not your feet.

speaker: Guard 4
en: I'm sick of this place. I really am.

speaker: Guard 5
en: Eight hours of this filth. Apistefto. (Unbelievable.)

speaker: Guard 6
en: The Grand Master has his reasons. I only wish I knew what they were.

speaker: Captain 2
en: Petros! Make sure we have enough torches for the excavation. I am tired of stumbling around in the dark.

speaker: Guard 7
en: Search every shadow!

speaker: Captain 3
en: There is someone down here with us. Keep your eyes open and your hands steady.

speaker: Guards
en: Get reinforcements! This is an attack! What was that? There! In the corner! I saw something. Where is he? They're coming from everywhere!

scene: You Should See the Other Guy
speaker: Federico
en: Hurry, Ezio. The sooner we're done with the doctor, the sooner we can sleep...

scene: You Should See the Other Guy
speaker: Federico
en: Ben trovato (Good to see you), doctor.

scene: You Should See the Other Guy
speaker: Ceresa
en: Hmmm... fratelli Auditore. (the Auditore brothers.) Why am I not surprised? You've made quite a mess of yourself, young man.

scene: You Should See the Other Guy
speaker: Ezio
en: It's nothing, really.

scene: You Should See the Other Guy
speaker: Federico
en: You must help him! That pretty face is his only asset.

scene: You Should See the Other Guy
speaker: Ezio
en: Fottiti! (Go fuck yourself!)

scene: You Should See the Other Guy
speaker: Ceresa
en: There we are. Now get out of here!

scene: You Should See the Other Guy
speaker: Ezio
en: Grazie.

scene: You Should See the Other Guy
speaker: Federico
en: This way.

speaker: Thief
en: Ezio Auditore? I expected a younger man! How could someone of your years be as swift as they claim? Prove it!

speaker: Zero Tolerance
en: was a virtual representation of one of Ezio Auditore da Firenze's genetic memories, relived by Desmond Miles in 2012 through the Animus.
